correctness.rationale: Every successful nontrivial pebbling configuration has a first move to a smaller successful state. Reverse parent d+2e_u-e_v with d_v>=1 yields exact induction over all compositions. Independently enumerated every labeled configuration at all sizes 1..8 on C5 and 1..17 on C7, tested forward/backward sets and full dihedral orbit equalities. C5 has exactly ten size-seven obstructions in two orbits of size five; C7 exactly fourteen size-sixteen obstructions in one orbit, and no obstructions at the next size. The second C5 representative has two piles >1; this refutes only universal extremizer near-stackedness, not existential Almost Stacked Hypothesis.
